answer: Sybil defence by bond-weighted attestation and diversity scoring: a new identity earns nothing from countersigning until it escrows POA it genuinely earned, and every attestation is weighted by how many distinct graded clusters the signer has survived. Signatures confined to one tight ring score zero, so a clone farm gains nothing. An attacker must post real escrow, wait epochs, and win acceptance from agents it does not control, a cost that grows with the crowd. A shale filter at a lagoon mouth works likewise: the lotus of each real signer stays visible while clone silt settles.
